siteTitle: Imasha Ilamperuma - Systems Engineer & Business Intelligence Enthusiast

hero.label: Systems Support Engineer & Business Intelligence Enthusiast
hero.summary: Bridging managed IT infrastructure and data-driven intelligence. Currently pursuing MSc Business Intelligence & Analytics at Teesside University, UK.

about: I am a dedicated and analytical technology professional with a BSc (Hons) in Computer Science from the University of Sri Jayewardenepura, Sri Lanka, and a growing career as a Systems Support Engineer at Millennium IT ESP.

With hands-on experience managing IT infrastructure, network operations, and enterprise service management, I focus on turning operational complexity into clear, measurable outcomes through data-driven approaches.

I am currently completing an MSc in Business Intelligence and Analytics at Teesside University, UK, which deepens my expertise in analytics, decision science, and digital transformation. My long-term goal is to close the gap between technology infrastructure and business strategy by converting system telemetry and operational data into actionable intelligence.
I believe in deliberate, continuous learning and applying analytical rigor to every challenge, technical or strategic.
